title: Best robot vacuum deal: Save $300 on Shark AV2511AE AI
excerpt: It works on carpets and hard floors.
content_html:
SAVE $300: As of Sept. 15, the Shark AV2511AE AI robot vacuum is on sale for $299.99 at Amazon. That's a 50% discount on the list price.

A robot vacuum won't make your entire chore list go away, but it can keep vacuuming off it entirely. Instead of having to dig out the vacuum every time the floors need attention, you can let a robot handle the regular dirt and dust for you. And if you've been looking for a deal on a great model, Amazon currently has an impressive discount on the Shark AV2511AE AI.

As of Sept. 15, this model is half off at Amazon, down from $599.99 to just $299.99.

This robot vacuum features powerful suction that picks up dirt and pet hair on both carpets and hard floors. It even has a self-cleaning brushroll that helps prevent hair wrap.

Its Matrix Clean technology uses a precision grid pattern to make multiple passes over messes, and the 360° LiDAR navigation maps your home and detects objects, even in the dark.
